channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: Why the Warriors’ short-handed win in Memphis is a template for their stretch run
item.description: Tanking is rampant in the NBA, and nine of Golden State’s final 23 games come against teams that are incentivized to lose.

item.title: How Bay FC’s new home kit compares with the best and worst local jerseys
item.description: The NWSL team unveiled a new look, leaning in on a bold color designed to match the California state flower.

item.title: BART Transbay Tube reopens after second closure in less than a week
item.description: A network engineering issue halted service between the West Oakland and 24th Street Mission stations.

item.title: OpenAI expands to the South Bay by leasing massive Mountain View campus
item.description: The deal for the former Norton LifeLock property locks the AI company into a 10-year stay.

item.title: ‘It just sucks’: BART director’s commute derailed by outage before agency board meeting
item.description: GM Bob Powers said his goal had been “no drama” after Sunday’s meltdown. “We failed on that.”

item.title: The 2028 MLB All-Star Game could be on its way to San Francisco
item.description: The Giants could cut the line to host if big-league players participate in the Olympics, sources say.

item.title: Kawakami: Trent Williams’ inevitable 49ers money, why negotiations get weird, and more
item.description: The franchise needs its star left tackle just as much as it needed him two years ago, when he held out through training camp.

item.title: Sam Smith is absolutely living for SF’s restaurant scene
item.description: Mother ate! The Grammy-winning U.K. musician, in town for a residency at the Castro, is posting about their dining exploits around town.

item.title: BART’s doomsday scenario has gotten slightly less doomy
item.description: Stations won’t close in January under the revised plan, but steep service cuts and possible closures still loom.

item.title: AI made him do it: Jack Dorsey lays off 40% of Block staff
item.description: “Intelligence tool capabilities have changed what it means to run a company,” CEO says
